notes.title: Version 1.0.3 patch notes
notes.notes: [p]Hello all,[/p][p][/p][p][b]This patch fixes/prevents save data from getting corrupted while playing and updating the game. If you have run into issues including: missing start buttons, invisible eggs, inaccurate frass, etc. this update should address these problems.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]If you are still experiencing playability issues after this update, please reach out to us at admin@bugaboopocket.com so we can assist you further.[/p][p][/p][p]You can also exclude our save file from being scanned by your antivirus software in the meantime: [url="https://docs.google.com/document/d/171kmttxuY5Z0pNlIA1mxuwjH7piDXAKWwMGZ9KxuCeE/edit?usp=share_link"]https://docs.google.com/document/d/171kmttxuY5Z0pNlIA1mxuwjH7piDXAKWwMGZ9KxuCeE/edit?usp=share_link[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Sorry for the long gap between updates! We were moving and dealing with some serious family matters but we are back now with plans to continue fixing issues and adding more content. If this patch doesn't cause further problems, our next focus will be adding the new bug to the game.[/p][p][/p][p]It's noodle time, baby![/p][p][/p][p]Sarah and Beth[/p]

notes.title: Hotfix for patch 1.0.2 available on save-data-hotfix beta branch
notes.notes:
Hello all,

[b]If the last patch caused your game to become glitchy/unplayable, there is now a hotfix available on the save-data-hotfix beta branch.[/b]

Here's how to switch onto the beta branch if you aren't sure how to do this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43144415/c650239fb51310d8dbf8be39eed36332e5032c7c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43144415/73534b3d648101f23b5fb290033969ec2d692af9.png[/img]

This should enable you to preserve your save file, though there may be some slight weirdness such as the amount of frass you have being incorrect.

[b]If you are still experiencing playability issues after the hotfix, you can restart your game in the settings menu or reach out to us at admin@bugaboopocket.com so we can assist you further.[/b]

If you haven't experienced problems with patch 1.0.2, we recommend that you continue to play on the main game branch, since we will continue to test and validate this fix for the rest of the week. We just wanted to make this change available ASAP for players who are waiting for it.

Sorry again for this issue! But we are hopeful this change brings a lot more stability to our game and makes it much easier for us to continue to update our game with patches and content.

Sarah and Beth

notes.title: Reported save file issue with patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
We have been getting some reports that our most recent patch is causing some previous save files to be corrupted, particularly if you were raising a mantis before the update.

We are working hard on a fix, which will hopefully allow these players to preserve their save data.

Unfortunately we cannot roll back this patch because this may cause even further save file corruption issues. [b]So if your game was in progress before the patch, particularly if you are raising a mantis, you may want to hold off on playing and updating the game.[/b]

You can prevent an automatic update by changing Bugaboo Pocket's preferences on Steam:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43144415/7d6a005399889d7766c645f19bf808eb375f5a47.png[/img]

[b]If you have updated your game and are having issues loading the game, we are working hard to fix it and will make an announcement next week when a new patch is ready to be tested on our beta branch.[/b]

We are very sorry that this update has been problematic.

Sarah and Beth

notes.title: Version patch notes 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hello everybuggy!

Our second patch contains even more bug fixes and improvements based on feedback!

[h3]Game improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Allow more pets before bugs become overstimulated.
[*] Increase rate of Magician card (which makes bugs become shiny) once game is beaten.
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Make letter 7 fully readable in computer view.
[*] Show food frass value even if food is free from Justice tarot card.
[*] Make sure music plays in tree level.
[*] Prevent final cutscene from playing multiple times.
[*] Make sure bug name is correct for Hierophant card when bug is small.
[*] Remove wishlist button.
[*] Allow moth to be photographed when flying.
[*] Correct a few bug facts.
[/list]

[h3]Outstanding issues[/h3]
[b]Save file corruption issues due to antivirus software[/b]
[list]
[*] After this patch I will be working on a way to save the game using a cache and creating backup saves that will hopefully prevent this from happening in the future.
[*] This can either cause your game to not load properly or for the bug to be missing from the terrarium.
[*] In the meantime, we now have a document that outlines how to exclude our save file from being scanned by [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/171kmttxuY5Z0pNlIA1mxuwjH7piDXAKWwMGZ9KxuCeE/edit?usp=drive_link]Windows Defender[/url].
[*] If you don't use Windows Defender, please reach out to us at admin@bugaboopocket.com for assistance.
[/list]

[b]Bug reverting back to egg[/b]
[list]
[*] I still cannot reproduce this behavior unfortunately.
[*] To help me debug this problem, I would love it if you could fill out [url=https://forms.gle/RjQvNeK3amMjrdcX6]this bug report[/url] form that addresses this issue specifically. 
[/list]

[b]Photos not loading in Garden/Specimen view[/b]
[list]
[*] I also cannot reproduce this on my end.
[*] If you've run into this, please reach out to us at admin@bugaboopocket.com to help us look into this issue further, thank you!
[/list]

[h3]New bug friend + furniture release[/h3]
We are in the process of adding new content and it will probably be available later this month! But we want to make sure that the patch(es) for save files are released first to ensure stability.

Thank you all again for playing our game!
Sarah and Beth

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 Patch notes
notes.notes:
Hello!

Thank you all so much for playing our game and sharing your thoughts. We've taken some of your feedback/bug reports and have incorporated them into this patch.

[b]There will be more patches to come! We are actively creating a list of reported issues but are trying to roll changes out slowly/incrementally to ensure the stability of the game.[/b]

[h3]Game improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*]Greatly increase minigame timer threshold
[*]Have 3 bug bins at the start of the game
[*]Added polished theme song and water level music
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fix Grub Grab third level to be winnable
[*]Decrease difficulty of Love is in the Air third level
[*]Recheck for Steam achievements if game goes offline
[*]Make Holey Roller sound effect less grating
[*]Hopefully prevent shrimp from getting stuck in It's A Floater
[/list]

[h3]Outstanding issues for the next patch[/h3]
[list]
[*]Bug reverting to egg right before bug dies - this is probably a race condition that will take a bit to track down/replicate.
[*]Memory photos not loading in Garden/Specimen view - I need to figure out whether or not this is due to the photos not saving or a bug in photo view logic.
[*]Corrupted save files - we are currently debugging this problem. It seems like it can be triggered if your antivirus software scans the save file while our game is writing to it. If you're experiencing this issue, please add an exception to files with the `es3` file type in your antivirus software.
If you're still running into this, please reach out to us at admin@bugaboopocket.com for assistance.
[*]Other bug fixes/improvements that didn't make it into this patch.
[/list]

[h2]Next content update[/h2]
We'll be doing a content update that includes:
[list]
[*]Brand new bug and minigames
[*]New furniture items
[/list]

Here's a teaser for our next bug! They're a spicy noodle so you may want to opt into the trigger warning before you raise one.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43144415/bb6480aecaca5fc4d150c53a18569d22e0bf4379.gif[/img]

Thank you for raising some bug friends,
Sarah and Beth

notes.title: Bugaboo Pocket is out now on Steam!
notes.notes:
Bugaboo Pocket is out now on Steam so it's time to get out there and make some invertebrate friends.

When we started working on this game, we were just making something that we ourselves wanted to play. We had no idea that this game would resonate with so many people, but we are so happy that it did.

We want to thank all of you in our community. The support and enthusiasm you've given us as we've slowly chipped away at this game helped us press on. Really, truly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43144415/6889f8eabd006c79c53e17f5a8f7bd4f578db841.png[/img]

Even though we've launched, we still have big plans for this game. Although we consider the game complete as is, we would love to add more bugs if there's enough interest!

The world is increasingly dark and scary, especially for people like us, but this game got us through some pretty hard times and we hope it does the same for you.

Have a buggy day,
The Bugaboo Pocket Team

notes.title: Bugaboo Pocket is part of Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
We know it's been a while but we have been working hard behind the scenes to get this game ready for you all to play.

[b]Although we really wanted to release this game in 2024, realistically we will be launching early 2025 on Steam. We will then release on Nintendo Switch after that.[/b]

But the game WILL be coming out soon. It is not canceled, not even close. We just need a bit more time since we are a tiny team with a lot of ambitious ideas that have taken a while to crystallize.

Thank you all for your patience. Your support keeps us going as we chip away at this game, one pixel at a time. Game development is insanely hard and we want to release something that will give you all the buggy goodness that you deserve.

If you haven't played our demo yet, it's a great Halloween treat. It is just a taste of what the full game has to offer. No tricks here!

Happy Halloween!
